presets.name: MUNICH BASS
presets.desc: The 1977 sequenced bass: root, octave, fifth and seventh in sixteenths, a saw and a square through the ladder filter, a tight pluck, the twin filters opening the stereo a little.

presets.name: GALLOP BASS
presets.desc: The galloping octave disco bass: a breathing pulse wave over a round sine sub, long first note and short answers, a ratchet closing every other beat.

presets.name: BOOGIE BASS
presets.desc: A swung boogie bass at 112: a square and a saw an octave below over a triangle sub, slides up to the octave, soft ghost notes between the accents.

presets.name: HI-NRG BASS
presets.desc: Hi-NRG at 130: octaves in sixteenths on two saws pulled apart by a few cents, stacked and spread wide, a sine sub keeping the low end centred.

presets.name: FUNK BASS
presets.desc: A rubbery funk bass in swung, syncopated sixteenths: a fat pulse with a triangle sub, the filter following the keys and snapping on the accents.

presets.name: ORBIT ROLL
presets.desc: A round bass rolling over eleven steps and sliding between its notes: a soft triangle over a sine sub, the twin filters turning it slightly in the stereo.

presets.name: ACID BASS
presets.desc: A soft acid line: one saw in the ladder filter, the resonance kept warm, slides tied into the next note and accents that open the filter a little.

presets.name: ACID ROLL
presets.desc: A hollow square acid bass at 110 in the Korg filter: five steps that slide and fold on themselves, warm resonance, a double hit at the end.

presets.name: CURSED BASS
presets.desc: A dark disco bass in eighths through the Korg filter: two saws an octave apart and a sine sub, the mixer pushed into the filter for growl, slow swelling notes.

presets.name: IRON ROLL
presets.desc: Hammered and martial: a hard sync bass, the second saw locked a fifth above the first, a dry snapping envelope, the last hit doubled.

presets.name: SUB BASS
presets.desc: The indie dance bass rolling between the kicks: a big sine sub, a pulse on top, the mixer pushed into the ladder filter for warmth.

presets.name: DUB BASS
presets.desc: A round dub bass in eighths: a soft triangle with a deep sine sub, the filter just open, long notes that breathe between the hits.

presets.name: PENDULUM BASS
presets.desc: Three eighths against eight, tied and sliding: a saw and a square, slow attacks, the twin filters of the Voyager wide apart.

presets.name: CRAWLER BASS
presets.desc: A dark descending bass with a reversed filter contour, the notes opening as they end, a square a fifth below for weight.

presets.name: RITUAL BASS
presets.desc: Five steps in the Korg filter: one note ratchets, two play only sometimes, a square an octave below, the resonance breathing over eight bars.

presets.name: TRIPLET BASS
presets.desc: Three short notes against the bar: a square and its fifth in a 12 dB filter, the third note doubled and sometimes left out, the cutoff slowly breathing.

presets.name: NEON ARP
presets.desc: An italo lead in eighths that slides into its high notes and ties them, a square against a saw, a slow filter swell and a gentle vibrato.

presets.name: PLUCK ARP
presets.desc: A classic poly pluck: two saws a few cents apart through a 12 dB low pass that snaps shut, swung offbeats and a double hit now and then.

presets.name: RATCHET ARP
presets.desc: A disco arpeggio with triple and quadruple ratchets inside it: a saw over a square an octave below, the ladder filter plucked on every note.

presets.name: OFFBEAT ARP
presets.desc: Offbeat organ stabs: two squares a fifth apart, short and round in a 12 dB filter, a double hit closing the bar.

presets.name: BRASS ARP
presets.desc: Analog brass in eighths: two detuned saws, stacked thick, the filter swelling open on each note like a horn section.

presets.name: DISCO KEYS ARP
presets.desc: Disco keys in sixteenths over two octaves of sevenths: a soft triangle edging to a saw and a hollow square, a round 12 dB filter, spread wide, a few notes left to chance.

presets.name: MOON ARP
presets.desc: Seven steps turning against sixteen: a pulse wave whose width breathes over four bars, a sine sub, the 12 dB filter drifting slowly.

presets.name: HOLLOW ARP
presets.desc: Nine steps against the bar: two squares an octave apart, hollow and woody, a breath of noise and the ladder filter slowly moving.

presets.name: DROPLET ARP
presets.desc: Random droplets over two octaves of ninths: a triangle plucked through a 12 dB filter, each note with its own brightness and its own odds of falling.

presets.name: GHOST ARP
presets.desc: Ghost notes for a minimal groove: a short square and saw blip on the octave, ratchets and odds on every step so the bar never comes back the same.

presets.name: WOOD ARP
presets.desc: A struck wooden key over seven steps: a sine and its octave with a touch of FM for the knock, a very short envelope, two notes left to chance.

presets.name: GLASS ARP
presets.desc: Nine glass steps against sixteen: a soft triangle with a hollow square an octave above, clear and round, the two blending over eight bars.

presets.name: STRING PAD
presets.desc: A string machine playing sevenths in eighths: two saws stacked and spread over the twin filters, soft attack, a short warm release.

presets.name: AURORA PAD
presets.desc: A slow arpeggiated pad over two octaves of ninths: a square and a saw stacked and spread, long attack, the filter breathing over four bars.

presets.name: FROZEN PAD
presets.desc: Cold random notes of an eleventh chord: a sine and a triangle a few cents apart, soft attacks and short tails, half of them left out, spread wide.

presets.name: VELVET PAD
presets.desc: Five quarter notes melting together in a closed ladder filter: two saws stacked thick, slow attack and release, the mix of the two drifting.

presets.name: SUNSET PAD
presets.desc: Arpeggiated sevenths up and down in sixteenths, an octave low: two triangles stacked and spread, soft attacks, the filter swaying over two bars.

presets.name: MIST PAD
presets.desc: A soft pad of slow random notes from an eleventh chord: a triangle and a quiet saw, a breath of filtered noise coming and going.

presets.name: GREY DRONE
presets.desc: Three long quarter notes against four, stacked saws down low over a sine sub, the wave shape drifting over four bars and the filter over eight.

presets.name: CATHEDRAL DRONE
presets.desc: A dark organ: two squares an octave apart over a sine sub, the filter half open, seven held notes turning slowly against the bar.

presets.name: DRIFT DRONE
presets.desc: A memory on a worn machine: a saw half way to a square and a triangle, the pitch wandering at random, the oscillators drifting far apart, a breath of hiss.

presets.name: OCEAN DRONE
presets.desc: A low tide of stacked saws and a square below, six slow notes spread across the twin filters, the cutoff rising and falling like a swell over eight bars.

presets.name: CRYPT ARP
presets.desc: A descent into the crypt: a pulse arpeggio falling over two octaves of sevenths in the Korg filter, a square sub, the pulse width jumping at random.

presets.name: SYNC GRIND
presets.desc: A dark hard sync lead in eighths: the second saw locked to the first and swept slowly over two bars, lightly stacked, the ladder filter keeping it warm.
